labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: how to strip markup/styles from a string. Rich provides Text.from_markup(...).plain.

body:
Rich has no function that strips markup from a string in place, but you can get the plain text of a markup string with `Text.from_markup(...).plain`:

```python
from rich.text import Text

Text.from_markup("[bold red]Settings[/] and [green]Colors[/]").plain
# 'Settings and Colors'
```

Search that plain text for your substring. If a string may contain square brackets that should stay literal, escape them with `rich.markup.escape` first. See [the markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). A related earlier question is #2016.

For usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
